24.overview: Counterterrorism agent Jack Bauer fights the bad guys of the world, a day at a time. With each week's episode unfolding in real-time, "24" covers a single day in the life of Bauer each season.

little house on the prarie.title: Little House on the Prairie
little house on the prarie.overview: The life and adventures of the Ingalls family in the nineteenth century American Midwest, focusing on their struggles, triumphs, and daily experiences in the small town of Walnut Grove, Minnesota.

superman.title: Superman & Lois
superman.overview: After years of facing megalomaniacal supervillains, monsters wreaking havoc on Metropolis, and alien invaders intent on wiping out the human race, the world's most famous superhero, Clark Kent, and comic books' most famous journalist, Lois Lane, come face to face with one of their greatest challenges ever - dealing with all the stress, pressures, and complexities that come with being working parents in today's society.

invincible.title: Invincible
invincible.overview: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager, except for the fact that his father, Omni-Man, is the most powerful superhero on the planet. Shortly after his seventeenth birthday, Mark begins to develop powers of his own and enters into his father's tutelage.

chuck.title: Chuck
chuck.overview: When Chuck Bartowski, a computer geek at the Buy More, accidentally downloads a database of government secrets into his brain, CIA and NSA agents are dispatched to protect him and utilize his new-found skills, turning his mundane life upside down.

smallville.title: Smallville
smallville.overview: An interpretation of the Superman mythology, Smallville chronicles the life of a young Clark Kent as he copes with his emerging superpowers and growing up in the Kansas town of Smallville.

buffy the vampire slayer.title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
buffy the vampire slayer.overview: A young woman, destined to slay vampires, demons, and other infernal creatures, fights her life of identity and destiny with the help of her close friends, the Scooby Gang.

big bang theory.title: The Big Bang Theory
big bang theory.overview: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

swamp thing.title: Swamp Thing
swamp thing.overview: CDC researcher Abby Arcane returns to her childhood home of Houma, Louisiana, to investigate a deadly swamp-borne virus. There, she develops a bond with scientist Alec Holland — only to have him tragically taken from her. But as powerful forces descend on Houma, Abby discovers that the swamp holds mystical and terrifying secrets, and the love of her life may not be dead after all.

seinfeld.title: Seinfeld
seinfeld.overview: The daily trials and tribulations of four neurotic friends living in New York City: stand-up comedian Jerry Seinfeld, his neurotic best friend George Costanza, his Elaine Benes, and his eccentric neighbor Cosmo Kramer.

3rd rock from the sun.title: 3rd Rock from the Sun
3rd rock from the sun.overview: A group of aliens are sent to Earth, which they deem to be an insignificant third-rate planet, to observe human behavior. Posing as a normal human family in an Ohio college town, they find that Earth's customs and emotions are far more complex than they ever expected.

3rd rock.title: 3rd Rock from the Sun
3rd rock.overview: The high commander of an alien expedition lands on Earth -- what he considers to be the least-important planet -- in human form as Dick Solomon. Along for the ride are his alien compatriots Harry, Sally and Tommy -- who is the eldest of the group but is now angrily trapped in a teen's body.

3rd rock of the sun.title: 3rd Rock Of The Sun
3rd rock of the sun.overview: A compelling television series tracking "3rd Rock Of The Sun". Log your progress, rate episodes, and stay tuned for the next season releases!

wonderman.title: Wonderman
wonderman.overview: A compelling television series tracking "Wonderman". Log your progress, rate episodes, and stay tuned for the next season releases!

from.title: FROM
from.overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

from.title: Live from E!
from.overview: The pre-show to the major award shows that airs on E! Entertainment Television. Live From the Red Carpet covers celebrity arrivals and gets you right up for a first-row seat to see the stars and all the excitement with live coverage of the fashion, flair, glitz and glamour.

from.title: Tales from the Darkside
from.overview: Tales from the Darkside is an anthology horror TV series created by George A. Romero, each episode was an individual short story that ended with a plot twist. The series' episodes spanned the genres of horror, science fiction, and fantasy, and some episodes featured elements of black comedy or more lighthearted themes.

from.title: From These Roots
from.overview: Follow the life of successful writer Elizabeth “Liz” Fraser Allen as she returns to her New England hometown of Strathfield to run her family’s newspaper after her father suffers a heart attack.

from.title: 3rd Rock from the Sun
from.overview: The high commander of an alien expedition lands on Earth -- what he considers to be the least-important planet -- in human form as Dick Solomon. Along for the ride are his alien compatriots Harry, Sally and Tommy -- who is the eldest of the group but is now angrily trapped in a teen's body.

from.title: Miles from Tomorrowland
from.overview: This intergalactic adventure charts the outer space missions of young adventurer Miles Callisto and his family – mom and ship captain, Phoebe; mechanical engineer dad, Leo; tech-savvy big sister, Loretta; and robo-ostrich pet, Merc – as they help connect the universe on behalf of the Tomorrowland Transit Authority.

american dad.title: American Dad!
american dad.overview: The series focuses on an eccentric motley crew that is the Smith family and their three housemates: Father, husband, and breadwinner Stan Smith; his better half housewife, Francine Smith; their college-aged daughter, Hayley Smith; and their high-school-aged son, Steve Smith. Outside of the Smith family, there are three additional main characters, including Hayley's boyfriend turned husband, Jeff Fischer; the family's man-in-a-goldfish-body pet, Klaus; and most notably the family's zany alien, Roger, who is "full of masquerades, brazenness, and shocking antics."

the madison.title: The Madison
the madison.overview: The Clyburns uproot their comfortable New York City lives to the wild, untamed beauty of Montana's Madison River Valley on a search for connection.

the madison.title: The Ashley Madison Affair
the madison.overview: The rise, fall, and improbable resurgence of Ashley Madison, the dating website aimed at marriage cheats. Pioneers in outrageous viral advertising, the company stops at nothing to gain publicity and by 2015 it appears to be on the brink of world domination. Then a team of hackers expose the intimate sexual secrets of millions of members, with devastating consequences. But in the aftermath of the data breach, are the site's adulterous users the only ones with dirty secrets?

the madison.title: The TS Madison Experience
the madison.overview: TS Madison sets out on a bold, unfiltered and authentic journey to be the first Black trans woman to host a mainstream talk show.

shogun.title: Shōgun
shogun.overview: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.

shogun.title: Shōgun

shogun.title: Abarenbo Shogun
shogun.overview:
Set in the 18th century, the show follows the Shogun Yoshimune, who likes to disguise himself as a low-ranking samurai and go into his capital of Edo to see the life of the common man, as well as to seek out and punish evildoers who would hurt his citizens. He is aided by Magistrate Oo'oka and a vivacious fireman, Tatsugoro, as well as a rotating cast of other recurring characters.

Along with Zenigata Heiji and Mito Kōmon, it ranks among the longest-running series in the jidaigeki genre. Like so many other jidaigeki, it falls in the category of kanzen-chōaku, loosely, "rewarding good and punishing evil."

data.reason: You praised Primal as 'darker, angrier and bloodier' and rated Castlevania 9/10. Invincible delivers that exact same visceral, high-octane animated storytelling paired with deep emotional drama and uncompromising action.

data.title: Dark

data.reason: Since you rated Severance a 9.7/10 for its unraveling mystery and loved the claustrophobic puzzle-box narrative of Silo, Dark is the ultimate next watch for you. Its intricate mystery and tense atmosphere will keep you hooked.

data.title: Andor
data.overview: In an era filled with danger, deception and intrigue, Cassian Andor will embark on the path that is destined to turn him into a rebel hero against the ruthless Galactic Empire.
data.reason: Given your praise for Shōgun's masterpiece dialogue and Succession's political intrigue, Andor delivers the absolute highest standard of prestige writing and tense espionage, elevating Sci-Fi into a grounded political thriller.

data.title: Severance
data.overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.
data.reason: Since you love dystopian sci-fi and mind-bending thrillers, Severance is an absolute must-watch. It delivers unmatched tension, dark humor, and high-concept mystery that fits your taste perfectly.

data.title: Solar Opposites
data.overview: A team of four aliens escape their exploding home world only to crash land into a move-in ready home in suburban America. They are evenly split on whether Earth is awful or awesome.
data.reason: As a major fan of Rick and Morty, Futurama, and South Park, Solar Opposites brings that exact hilarious, unhinged sci-fi animation comedy you thrive on.

data.title: Fallout
data.overview: In a future, post-apocalyptic Los Angeles brought about by nuclear decimation, citizens must live in underground bunkers to protect themselves from radiation, mutants, and bandits.
data.reason: Given your interest in post-apocalyptic themes like The Walking Dead and dystopian settings, Fallout combines pitch-black comedy with incredible apocalyptic world-building.

data.title: Invincible
data.overview: An adult animated series based on the Skybound/Image comic about a teenager whose father is the most powerful superhero on the planet.
data.reason: Your heavy watching history of top-tier adult animation like Arcane and Blue Eye Samurai makes Invincible a flawless fit with its visceral action and dark storytelling.

data.title: Silo
data.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets.
data.reason: Your appetite for gripping dystopian thrillers makes Silo a standout match. Its intense mystery and rich underground atmosphere will keep you hooked.
